item.title: Version 1.18.3
item.description:
New

  • Screenshot support
  • Permissions tab in settings
  • On-device audio-transcription
  • Support for recording a specific display

Improved

  • One-click menu bar to stop recording
  • Allow multi-selecting timeline items
  • Improved cursor designs
  • Permission UI shown when update causes missing permissions
  • Match export name to recorded video name
  • Updated spacing in sidebar inspector card elements

Fixed

  • Text editing CMD+ controls for license entry
  • Prevent inadvertent blurring on final export when cursor is stationary
  • SVG bundling
